methodology: dist builds (fat LTO) of the baseline and the changed grit-cli. Isolated config environment (GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null). Five warmups, then interleaved rounds of system Git, baseline grit and changed grit with rotating order (600 rounds for log and show, 400 for status and diff, 60 for blame, 45 for the counts). Wall time is spawn to waitpid in Python. No builds or tests ran during measurement.

profile.tool: valgrind callgrind (instructions, median of three runs) and getrusage minor faults (median of 40 runs)
